title: Gloze
summary: GLOZE, verb intransitive To flatter; to wheedle; to fawn; that is, to smooth, or to talk smoothly. So glozed the tempter, and his proem tun'd. A false glozing parasite. GLOZE, noun Flattery; adulation

inlines.v: GLOZE, verb intransitive To flatter; to wheedle; to fawn; that is, to smooth, or to talk smoothly. So glozed the tempter, and his proem tun'd. A false glozing parasite. GLOZE, noun Flattery; adulation. 1. Specious show; gloss. [Not used. See Gloss.]
